subject: Vendor onboarding: PO-ack, invoice routing options, and XML sample request
messages:
From: Emily Torres <emily.torres@paybridge.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Apr 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice routing & PO ack fields

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the onboarding packet — PayBridge is ready to wire up billing. A couple quick items before we start sending live invoices:

- We can push invoices via your portal API, via SMTP to billing@redwood.com, or drop XML files over SFTP. Curious which you prefer for initial go-live (we typically start SMTP for small partners then migrate to API).
- Attached is our current invoice_schema_v1.xml (stub). It includes fields we typically populate: InvoiceNumber, InvoiceDate, Currency, SupplierTaxID, RemitTo (address), multiple Line items with UnitPrice/Qty, and Embedded POReferences.

Two specific questions on your side:
1) PO acknowledgement — you listed an "orderConfirmation" field in your vendor form. Do you need a separate PO-ACK message (yes/no) or is embedding PO references on the invoice sufficient? If you do need ACKs, what exact fields do you require back from us?
2) Invoice matching rules — what happens when a single invoice references multiple POs? Do you require PO-level split lines or a single invoice with multiple POReference elements?

I copied ops@paybridge.com in case they want to add technical details.

Examples attached and happy to hop on a 30-minute call this week.

Thanks,
Emily Torres
Business Ops — PayBridge Inc.
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Apr 2028 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice routing & PO ack fields

Hi Emily — thanks for this and for attaching the schema. Quick answers up front, then a couple asks so we can give you a clean integration path: 

- Preferred path: portal API (best for idempotency, observability, and per-invoice metadata). SMTP is supported as a fallback for the first 30 days of a pilot. SFTP is fine for batched partners but requires extra onboarding.
- PO acknowledgements: Redwood does not require a separate outbound PO-ACK for standard procurements. We key matching on PO numbers embedded on the invoice and our AP system performs a multi-PO match if the invoice contains multiple <POReference> entries. If you prefer per-PO acknowledgement we can enable an optional webhook (we emit status: RECEIVED | MATCHED | EXCEPTION).

What we need from you to avoid exceptions on day one: 
1) Minimal required fields: InvoiceNumber, InvoiceDate (ISO 8601), SupplierTaxID, RemitTo (structured address lines), Currency (ISO 4217), LineItems with Description, Quantity, UnitPrice, InvoiceTotal, and at least one POReference element with an attribute poType and PO number.
2) If you will send one invoice that covers multiple POs, include repeated <POReference> elements and for any line that applies to a PO add an optional line-level PORef attribute (we will accept both).
3) For idempotency please include an InvoiceUUID (GUID) header or XML node. Redwood will use InvoiceUUID+SupplierTaxID as the dedupe key.

Attachments we can consume: XML (preferred), PDF (for human view), and CSV (for bulk). If you plan to send signed XML (x509/PKCS7 or detached PGP), include the signature file as a sibling object and specify "x-signature-type" in the envelope.

I'll attach two examples (redwood_invoice_examples.xml) and our procurement_onboarding_form.pdf so you can map fields to our vendor record.

Next step: can you confirm whether PayBridge will start with SMTP fallback or go straight to the portal API? If SMTP, please use subject token pattern: INV|<SupplierTaxID>|<InvoiceNumber> (helps routing). If API, we'll provision client credentials and a test endpoint.

If useful we can schedule a short technical sync. I have a slot Wed 11:00-11:30 PT.

Best,
Monica Patel
Procurement Program Manager — Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_invoice_examples.xml, procurement_onboarding_form.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Apr 2028 10:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice routing & PO ack fields

Thanks Emily / Monica — couple of operational edge cases from our side (apologies for the list):

- Currency and VAT: if invoices include VAT at line level we need a VATAmount and VATRate per line. For US vendors this can be zero, but EU vendors must provide VATRegistrationNumber.
- Multi-currency settlement: Redwood settles in base currency per contract; please include OriginalCurrency and OriginalLineAmounts when Currency != USD.
- PO hold/unmatched exceptions: if we can’t match a line to any PO we route to Ops and add EXCEPTION tags. If you can emit a suggested GLCode or CostCenter attribute on lines that helps accelerate routing.
- Subject token enforcement: Monica mentioned INV|SupplierTaxID|InvoiceNumber — ops will reject emails without a token after pilot cutoff. Please confirm you can add that to SMTP subject formatting.
- Signing and encryption: do you support encrypted SFTP and x509-signed XML envelopes? If not, we can start with unsigned XML and add mutual TLS later.

Last ask: any chance you can provide a 10-line sample XML with a multi-PO invoice and a VAT line? That will let our test harness validate schema mapping.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference

Hi Monica / Karthik — great, thanks for the detail. Quick confirmations: 

- We'll start SMTP fallback for the pilot and add the subject token INV|941234567|<InvoiceNumber> as requested.
- PayBridge can emit both repeated <POReference> elements and per-line PORef attributes; we'll include both to be safe.
- We can add InvoiceUUID and OriginalCurrency nodes.
- Regarding signatures: PayBridge supports detached PGP signatures today and can provide x509 signing within two sprints if required.

I'll attach a 10-line sample multi-PO XML by EOD and a short timeline for connector work (we estimate 2 weeks to pilot with SMTP and 4 weeks to move to API).

Would you like us to fill the procurement_onboarding_form and return it to vendor-ops@redwood.com or upload to the portal?

Emily

Business Ops — PayBridge Inc.
